diagnosis: The proof repeatedly unpacks bisimilarity into an underlying relation and then reconstructs bisimilarity via `le_bisimilarity`. `HomBisimilarity.follow_fst` and `follow_snd` already provide bisimilar successor states directly, allowing a shorter and substantially lighter proof.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  use @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor
  · intro s1' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨q', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨q', Tr.choiceL htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨q', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨q', htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
  · intro s2' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice h =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨p', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨p', Tr.choiceL htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
    | bisim h =>
      obtain ⟨p', htr, h⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨p', htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim h⟩
